title: Drift detection
one_line: Measure how consistent a model's answers are across repeated runs.
verified_against: Rust core and native binding tests run the real calculator; the facade tests in tests/ use a mock core. Needs the compiled core.
snippet:
from briefcase.drift import DriftCalculator

d = DriftCalculator()
m = d.calculate_drift(["positive", "positive", "negative"])
print(m.consistency_score, m.consensus_output)
